items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For a while we had Chico, Purcell and Murray I believe.

ctx.x: Then this group, “Special Edition” goes through various evolutions as well because when David and Black Arthur Blythe leave then Chico Freeman and John Purcell come in. So, continually evolving but maintaining your vision for an ensemble sound, continuing to write for these groups. Do you want to talk about that evolution and what that leads to at this point?
Yeah… The change of personnel. Peter Warren leaves, and he was replaced by Rufus Reid. For a while we had Chico, Purcell and Murray I believe.
So you had a three (horn) frontline then?
